word.name: concept header for the concept of word wrappers
word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Word Wrappers

conceptHeader.description: The word-wrapper is Tapestry's canonical JSON format for the 'json' tag of any core node or firmware concept event. It has two sections: (1) a universal 'word' key with slug, name, title, wordTypes array, and coreMemberOf array; (2) one or more type-specific keys (conceptHeader, superset, set, property, primaryProperty, graph, conceptGraph, coreNodesGraph, propertyTreeGraph) containing the node's structured data. The format allows a single event to simultaneously represent multiple node types by having multiple type-specific sections. Element data outside firmware uses the concept's camelCase key (e.g., 'dog') as its namespace.
